final_message: I parsed the log file by splitting it into entries based on the timestamp, level, service, and message pattern. I included only entries with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, uppercased the level, extracted the message after the service name, and took the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. I also accounted for repeated messages by summing the repeat counts. Finally, I aggregated counts by service and wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
